title: Aoyagi Toya — Outdoor Cooking!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Aboard a train

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Finally, our last train change...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, we should be at our station in about an hour, and a bus will take us the rest of the way.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Cool. That means we can chill for a while.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah... Oh, I should tell my mom that we managed to catch our connection before I forget...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. That's right. Your mom did seem more worried about us missing a train than going out camping.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I love the way she said, This is your first time going to this place, so don't get too absorbed in the scenery.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, she has a habit of saying that because of my dad, so I'm guessing she's worried about me doing the same thing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I understand what she means. Anyone would want to take their time looking around if it's somewhere they've never been before.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Wait, Toya...
Did you tell your dad about us going camping...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, I mean, wasn't he totally against you dropping everything to go do street music instead?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But you're here, so that means he must've agreed to let you go.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, he did. Well, after I detailed everything out in a presentation.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, a presentation?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. It was to show him why exactly I needed to go on this trip.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I even put together supplementary figures and documents to explain what we'd be doing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: About two hours in he said, I'm busy with work, so do as you please.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Two hours...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sounds like your passionate speech overpowered him.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But it's nice to hear that your dad seems to understand, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
So am I.
But there's still a bit of a problem...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: A problem? Did him agreeing to this come with some strings attached?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, it has to do with my presentation and how it has a fatal flaw.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It does?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. Ultimately, I was able to convince him by using words to explain how important it is for me to go on this trip.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But that took far too long to actually explain.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, two hours is a bit much...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So if I have to do this again, he could just turn me down by saying, I don't have time right now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Which is why I need to think of a quicker and more digestible way to explain things next time.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That's amazing. You're already planning that far ahead!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But you're really good at explaining stuff, Aoyagi, so I'm sure you'll think of something!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thanks, Azusawa.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's hard to say when next time is...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
But we'll deal with it then.
I'm sure the four of us can come up with something.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I'd like that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The scenery's changed quite a bit...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We've gone from buildings and skyscrapers to a much greener landscape.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, look...!
There are cows grazing on that hillside.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, you're right!
There's so many!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Are those wild cows...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
No way, dude.
That's gotta be someone's farm, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Probably.
Oh, I see a bunch of rice fields through the windows on the other side!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Looks like they've already harvested everything. It feels really somber for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: If only we'd come sooner. I'm guessing it was really pretty with all those rice stalks dancing in the wind.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Pretty, huh...? I've seen videos of fields like this, but never the real thing...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Really...?
But rice fields give you some of the best fall photos.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You know how rice stalks turn yellow just before they're harvested? They become this beautiful golden color as the sun sets at dusk.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And the wind makes them all rustle in a way that sounds like waves are crashing on a beach.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Like a beach...
That really must be something you can only enjoy during the right time of year.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Come to think of it, my dad told us something similar when we went camping that one time...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
And it's absolutely gorgeous, right?!
It reminds me of when we harvested rice during elementary school.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, would you guys mind telling me more about your experiences...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So we can all get on the same page...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, would that be alright?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Of course. Actually, I might have some albums and videos still saved on my phone.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thanks, Azusawa.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And I can tell you more about harvesting rice! Although, it was a long time ago, so I don't exactly remember everything...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But we have plenty of time until our next stop, so knock yourself out, dude.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you, Shiraishi, Akito.
I really appreciate it.
